subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw support the restored five-page Wear companion product surface—including phone-proxy agent/Gateway controls and durable Watch-local theme and Auto-Speak preferences—as the maintained Android contract?
rationale: The patch supplies a bounded implementation and compatibility gate, but source-level correctness cannot determine whether this expanded mobile product scope and its persistent defaults are the desired long-term supported surface.

options.title: Confirm the restored Wear contract
options.body: Accept the full paired-phone companion scope and its explicit capability/default contracts, then merge after normal exact-head gates finish.

options.title: Narrow the companion surface
options.body: Retain only the previously intended Wear interactions and remove controls or settings that the Android owner does not want to support durably.

recommendation.title: Confirm the restored Wear contract
recommendation.body: Accept the full paired-phone companion scope and its explicit capability/default contracts, then merge after normal exact-head gates finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the latest integration-hardening commits on the affected Wear path.
